title: webauthn.me: register and sign in

unsafe.definition: the response has user verification set although nothing verified this request (no recent unlock, no PRF, PIN or master password)
the response has user presence set without a trusted click in Ferret's own window or popup

note: A smoke test against a public demo site: registration and sign-in work in both channels (extension/test/firefox/passkeyDemo.mjs). Needs a network that reaches the site, so this set runs outside the test network.
